ayahs.textAr: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.textEn: By Mount Ṭûr!

ayahs.textAr: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And by the Book written

ayahs.textAr: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: on open pages ˹for all to read˺!

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.textEn: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited!

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.textEn: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺!

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.textEn: And by the seas set on fire!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

ayahs.textAr: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: none will avert it—

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
ayahs.textEn: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently,

ayahs.textAr: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
ayahs.textEn: and the mountains will be blown away entirely.

ayahs.textAr: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.textAr: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: those who amuse themselves with falsehood!

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.textEn: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell.

ayahs.textAr: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ayahs.textAr: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Is this magic, or do you not see?

ayahs.textAr: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss,

ayahs.textAr: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire.

ayahs.textAr: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textAr: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed.

ayahs.textAr: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.textEn: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire.

ayahs.textAr: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness.

ayahs.textAr: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls.

ayahs.textAr: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: They will turn to one another inquisitively.

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people.

ayahs.textAr: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textEn: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.textAr: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.textEn: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O  Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”?

ayahs.textAr: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith.

ayahs.textAr: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true!

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺!

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

ayahs.textAr: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.textEn: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.textEn: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

ayahs.textAr: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.textEn: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.
